dedupe_keys.name: data transportation gov us department of transportation public data portal

description: Data.Transportation.gov is the US Department of Transportation's public data portal. Its home page welcomes users, offers a view of which DOT datasets are being accessed and used, and featured the NHTSA Takata recall repair data on 2026-09-29. Several records already in the catalogue, such as HPMS, the National Transit Database, NGSIM trajectories and PHMSA pipeline incident and operator data, are published through it, so it serves as the entry point to DOT modal datasets. Coverage: US federal transport data across modes. Format and access: web portal with dataset pages and APIs. Licence and cost: free; terms per dataset. Caveats: the home page does not give a dataset count, and many DOT datasets also live on modal agency sites. It supports network flow, hazard exposure and resilience studies that draw on federal transport data. It relates to HPMS, the National Transit Database, NGSIM and PHMSA incident data in the catalogue.
